invariants.why: discarding is the default outcome; a pipeline that usually writes is a pipeline that propagates errors
the reason importance alone never authorises a write
a rule stripped of its scope gets applied where it is false - the most damaging over-compression
the regression gate has no third branch; promoting with a caveat defeats it
a new skill is a draft for review; an unreviewed skill in the catalog is already routing traffic
